D.2.3 Determinación de la temperatura del acero

attributes.meta_summary: This section details the method for determining the temperature of steel elements (beams or supports) under fire conditions, both for uncoated and coated steel, using an incremental calculation based on the variation of the sector's temperature.

extractions.extraction_text: Para comprobar vigas o soportes, en función de la variación de los parámetros mecánicos del acero, establecidas en la tabla D.2, es preciso obtener la temperatura en el elemento, mediante un cálculo incremental, de acuerdo con la variación de la temperatura del sector.

attributes.Procedure: To check beams or supports, based on the variation of the mechanical parameters of steel established in Table D.2, the temperature in the element must be obtained through an incremental calculation, according to the variation of the sector's temperature.

attributes.Procedure: For uncoated steel, the temperature increment in the steel, s,t, assuming it is uniformly distributed in the section, over a time increment t, is determined by the provided expression. The expression involves: A m /V (shape factor from D.2.1), cs (specific heat of steel, 600 J/kgK), h'net,d (net heat flux per unit area, sum of radiation h'net,r and convection h'net,c),  (configuration factor, 1.0 if no specific data), f (fire emissivity, 1.0 if no specific data), m (surface emissivity of steel, 0.50), r (effective radiation temperature in the fire sector, equal to gas temperature per B.2), s (surface temperature of the element),  (Boltzmann constant, 5.67·10^-8 W/m2 K4), c (convection heat transfer coefficient, 25 W/m2 K for normalized time-temperature curve, or 9 W/m2 K for non-exposed side of separating elements), t (time interval, not exceeding 5 seconds), and s (density of steel, 7850 kg/m3).

attributes.Procedure: For coated steel, the temperature increment in the steel, s,t, assuming it is uniformly distributed in the section, over a time increment t, is determined by the provided expression. The expression involves: A m /V (from D.2.3), d (from D.2.1), g,t (gas temperature at time t), s,t (steel temperature at time t), p (thermal conductivity of coating material), cp (specific heat of coating), cs (specific heat of steel), p (density of coating), and s (from D.2.3).
